plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's dreams. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension:
The Neptune person may begin loving the image as much as the person. The Venus person may begin performing the image because being adored this way feels good. Over time, the pedestal becomes heavy. You cannot have an ordinary mood. You cannot need too much. You cannot be inconvenient without the dream flickering.

Reality always arrives. And when it does, there can be a moment of grief. Not because the love was false, but because no human being can fully embody a dream. The challenge is letting the relationship become real without treating reality as a loss.
advice: The work is to choose the real person again and again. Let the romance stay alive, but do not ask anyone to become a symbol.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism.
